pixel_description: Pixel-only view: light wall with concrete stairs on right. Center black trolley with vertical spine pole from base to top, topped by angled black grip handle with pivot bolts. Brown cardboard box sits on horizontal black rectangular toe plate mid-height. Toe plate joined to lower spine frame. Under toe plate two clusters of small black wheels, each 3 wheels with vertical swivel stems, contacting ground. Behind lower spine a silver perforated disc bracket with two small black wheels resting on stair nosing edge. Light-blue straight up-arrow floating right of spine, small light-blue up-arrow below spine bracket, light-blue curved arrow under toe front, red curved arrow at disc. Visible labels exactly: 'spine' with leader to mid-spine, 'deadman disc' with leader to silver disc, 'twin fixed tri-stars' with leader dot on toe plate edge, 'wheels' with leader to front lower wheel cluster, '~100 mm' with teal scale bar bottom-left, footer 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established', 'A' top-left. Physically seen: spine rigidly meets toe frame, toe meets wheel stems, disc bracket meets spine base; no clutch cylinder, no lock levers, no triangular star plates, no folding hinges visible.
label_findings: 'spine' ok, 'deadman disc' ok, 'wheels' ok - spelling correct and leaders end on spine pole, perforated disc, lower wheel cluster. 'twin fixed tri-stars' WRONG PLACEMENT - text spelled correct but leader dot sits on edge of black toe plate (H2 folding toe) not on R95 star arms/wheels below. H1 folding handle, H2 folding toe, CSK30, DESTACO lock have no labels. Scale '~100 mm' and footer 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established' and 'A' are not part names.

Plus render omits CSK30 clutch cylinder at spine base, omits DESTACO locks at H1/H2, shows swivel caster clusters under toe and trailing disc-arm on stair instead of twin fixed R95 triangular stars on fixed spine-star axle, shows no folding hinges, shows decorative blue/red arrows that do not encode H2->spine->stars / CSK->disc, relative wheel size ambiguous vs ~100mm bar.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed. Schematic correctly shows fixed stars, CSK30, disc, H1/H2, locks and loads. All faults are depiction omissions in render (missing clutch/locks, wrong star geometry, misplaced leader, meaningless arrows). Concrete feature: silver perforated disc and lower wheel clusters are present but star plates/clutch/locks are simply not drawn.
notes: Render carries disclaimer 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established' so hold 38.5Nm/405N 60s and metered 40.5N not proven. Scale bar '~100 mm' present bottom-left. Blue up-arrows and red curved arrow are decorative flow overlay with no values. Schematic itself contains all parts/loads/connections per solution.
